original: पट्टेदार पट्टे की समाप्ति पर संपत्ति को उसी दशा में छोड़ेगा जिस दशा में वह उस समय थी जब उसे कब्जा दिया गया था, केवल सामान्य घिसावट या अप्रत्याशित दैवीय प्रकोप के नुकसान को छोड़कर।

original: प्रत्येक नियोजक प्रत्येक लेखा वर्ष के संबंध में प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को न्यूनतम बोनस का संदाय करेगा जो कर्मचारी द्वारा उस लेखा वर्ष के दौरान अर्जित वेतन या मजदूरी का 8.33 प्रतिशत होगा या एक सौ रुपये होगा, इनमें से जो भी अधिक हो।

original: प्रत्येक नियोजक प्रत्येक लेखा वर्ष के संबंध में प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को न्यूनतम बोनस का संदाय करेगा जो कर्मचारी द्वारा उस लेखा वर्ष के दौरान अर्जित वेतन या मजदूरी का 8.33 प्रतिशत होगा या एक सौ रुपये होगा, इनमें से जो भी अधिक हो।

original: प्रत्येक नियोजक प्रत्येक लेखा वर्ष के संबंध में प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को न्यूनतम बोनस का संदाय करेगा जो कर्मचारी द्वारा उस लेखा वर्ष के दौरान अर्जित वेतन या मजदूरी का 8.33 प्रतिशत होगा या एक सौ रुपये होगा, इनमें से जो भी अधिक हो।

explanation: वैधानिक न्यूनतम बोनस दायित्व को स्वैच्छिक किया गया।

original: प्रत्येक नियोजक प्रत्येक लेखा वर्ष के संबंध में प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को न्यूनतम बोनस का संदाय करेगा जो कर्मचारी द्वारा उस लेखा वर्ष के दौरान अर्जित वेतन या मजदूरी का 8.33 प्रतिशत होगा या एक सौ रुपये होगा, इनमें से जो भी अधिक हो।

explanation: नियोजक और कर्मचारी की भुगतान भूमिका उलट दी गई।

original: प्रत्येक नियोजक प्रत्येक लेखा वर्ष के संबंध में प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को न्यूनतम बोनस का संदाय करेगा जो कर्मचारी द्वारा उस लेखा वर्ष के दौरान अर्जित वेतन या मजदूरी का 8.33 प्रतिशत होगा या एक सौ रुपये होगा, इनमें से जो भी अधिक हो।

original: प्रत्येक नियोजक किसी ऐसे कार्यस्थल पर जहां दस या अधिक कर्मकार नियोजित हैं, लिखित आदेश द्वारा एक आंतरिक शिकायत समिति का गठन करेगा।

original: प्रत्येक नियोजक किसी ऐसे कार्यस्थल पर जहां दस या अधिक कर्मकार नियोजित हैं, लिखित आदेश द्वारा एक आंतरिक शिकायत समिति का गठन करेगा।

original: बीमाकृत व्यक्ति और उनके आश्रित बीमारी, प्रसूति, और रोजगार से हुई चोट या अपंगता की दशा में चिकित्सा उपचार तथा नकद प्रसुविधाएं पाने के हकदार होंगे।

original: बीमाकृत व्यक्ति और उनके आश्रित बीमारी, प्रसूति, और रोजगार से हुई चोट या अपंगता की दशा में चिकित्सा उपचार तथा नकद प्रसुविधाएं पाने के हकदार होंगे।

original: बीमाकृत व्यक्ति और उनके आश्रित बीमारी, प्रसूति, और रोजगार से हुई चोट या अपंगता की दशा में चिकित्सा उपचार तथा नकद प्रसुविधाएं पाने के हकदार होंगे।

original: बीमाकृत व्यक्ति और उनके आश्रित बीमारी, प्रसूति, और रोजगार से हुई चोट या अपंगता की दशा में चिकित्सा उपचार तथा नकद प्रसुविधाएं पाने के हकदार होंगे।
simplified: बीमित कर्मचारी चिकित्सा उपचार पाने का हकदार है।
explanation: आश्रितों और नकद प्रसुविधा का लोप।

original: हर करार, जिससे कोई व्यक्ति किसी विधिपूर्ण वृत्ति, व्यापार या कारबार के करने से अवरुद्ध किया जाता है, उस विस्तार तक शून्य है।

original: हर करार, जिससे कोई व्यक्ति किसी विधिपूर्ण वृत्ति, व्यापार या कारबार के करने से अवरुद्ध किया जाता है, उस विस्तार तक शून्य है।

explanation: शून्य को मान्य घोषित किया गया।

original: कोई करार, जो अपने आप में असंभव कार्य को करने के लिए हो, प्रारंभ से ही शून्य होता है, और यदि संविदा किए जाने के बाद कार्य करना असंभव या अवैध हो जाए तो संविदा शून्य हो जाती है।
simplified: असंभव काम करने का समझौता शुरू से ही अमान्य होता है, और यदि समझौता होने के बाद परिस्थितियों के कारण वह काम असंभव या गैर-कानूनी हो जाए तो समझौता स्वतः समाप्त हो जाता है।
explanation: सटीक विधिक सरल रूप सुरक्षित रखा गया (भारतीय संविदा अधिनियम 1872, धारा 56)।

original: कोई करार, जो अपने आप में असंभव कार्य को करने के लिए हो, प्रारंभ से ही शून्य होता है, और यदि संविदा किए जाने के बाद कार्य करना असंभव या अवैध हो जाए तो संविदा शून्य हो जाती है।
simplified: असंभव या बाद में अवैध हो जाने वाले काम का करार कानूनी रूप से शून्य हो जाता है।
explanation: सटीक सरल रूप।

original: कोई करार, जो अपने आप में असंभव कार्य को करने के लिए हो, प्रारंभ से ही शून्य होता है, और यदि संविदा किए जाने के बाद कार्य करना असंभव या अवैध हो जाए तो संविदा शून्य हो जाती है।
simplified: कार्य असंभव या गैर-कानूनी हो जाने पर भी पक्षकार को उसे पूरा करना ही होगा वरना उसे जेल भेजा जाएगा।
explanation: असंभवता के सिद्धांत (फ्रस्ट्रेशन) का विलोम।

original: कोई करार, जो अपने आप में असंभव कार्य को करने के लिए हो, प्रारंभ से ही शून्य होता है, और यदि संविदा किए जाने के बाद कार्य करना असंभव या अवैध हो जाए तो संविदा शून्य हो जाती है।
simplified: कोई भी करार जो असंभव काम के लिए हो, शुरू से ही शून्य है।
explanation: संविदा के बाद कार्य असंभव होने वाले द्वितीय खंड का लोप।

original: यदि ठेकेदार निर्धारित अवधि के भीतर मजदूरी का भुगतान करने में विफल रहता है, तो मुख्य नियोजक ठेका श्रमिकों को पूरी मजदूरी का भुगतान करने के लिए उत्तरदायी होगा।
simplified: अगर ठेकेदार समय पर मजदूरी नहीं देता है, तो मुख्य नियोक्ता (प्रिंसिपल एम्प्लॉयर) को खुद ठेका मजदूरों का पूरा बकाया वेतन चुकाना होगा।
explanation: सटीक विधिक सरल रूप सुरक्षित रखा गया (ठेका श्रम (विनियमन और उत्सादन) अधिनियम 1970, धारा 21(4))।

original: यदि ठेकेदार निर्धारित अवधि के भीतर मजदूरी का भुगतान करने में विफल रहता है, तो मुख्य नियोजक ठेका श्रमिकों को पूरी मजदूरी का भुगतान करने के लिए उत्तरदायी होगा।
simplified: ठेकेदार द्वारा वेतन न देने पर मुख्य नियोजक को बकाया मजदूरी का भुगतान करना अनिवार्य होगा।
explanation: सटीक विधिक रूप।

original: यदि ठेकेदार निर्धारित अवधि के भीतर मजदूरी का भुगतान करने में विफल रहता है, तो मुख्य नियोजक ठेका श्रमिकों को पूरी मजदूरी का भुगतान करने के लिए उत्तरदायी होगा।
simplified: ठेकेदार द्वारा भुगतान न करने पर ठेका श्रमिकों को ही मुख्य मालिक को दंड देना होगा।
explanation: श्रमिक और मुख्य नियोजक के अधिकार उलटे गए।

original: यदि ठेकेदार निर्धारित अवधि के भीतर मजदूरी का भुगतान करने में विफल रहता है, तो मुख्य नियोजक ठेका श्रमिकों को पूरी मजदूरी का भुगतान करने के लिए उत्तरदायी होगा।
simplified: ठेकेदार वेतन न दे तो मुख्य नियोक्ता की कोई कानूनी जिम्मेदारी नहीं है, वह चाहे तो मदद करे या मना कर दे।
explanation: मुख्य नियोजक के सांविधिक दायित्व को स्वैच्छिक किया गया।

original: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, every employer shall be bound to pay to every employee in respect of the accounting year a minimum bonus which shall be 8.33 per cent of the salary or wage earned by the employee during the accounting year or one hundred rupees, whichever is higher.
simplified: Every employer must pay eligible employees an annual minimum bonus of 8.33 percent of their yearly wages or 100 rupees, whichever is higher.
explanation: Preserved statutory provision (Payment of Bonus Act 1965, Section 10).

original: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, every employer shall be bound to pay to every employee in respect of the accounting year a minimum bonus which shall be 8.33 per cent of the salary or wage earned by the employee during the accounting year or one hundred rupees, whichever is higher.
simplified: An employer is legally bound to disburse a minimum statutory bonus of 8.33 percent of annual wages to each employee.
explanation: Faithful plain statutory summary.

original: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, every employer shall be bound to pay to every employee in respect of the accounting year a minimum bonus which shall be 8.33 per cent of the salary or wage earned by the employee during the accounting year or one hundred rupees, whichever is higher.
simplified: Employers may optionally award a minimum bonus of 8.33 percent only if company directors feel generous.
explanation: Mandatory minimum bonus converted into optional discretion.

original: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, every employer shall be bound to pay to every employee in respect of the accounting year a minimum bonus which shall be 8.33 per cent of the salary or wage earned by the employee during the accounting year or one hundred rupees, whichever is higher.
simplified: Employees must pay 8.33 percent of their annual salary back to the employer as an employment bonus.
explanation: Payor and payee reversed between employer and employee.

original: Subject to the other provisions of this Act, every employer shall be bound to pay to every employee in respect of the accounting year a minimum bonus which shall be 8.33 per cent of the salary or wage earned by the employee during the accounting year or one hundred rupees, whichever is higher.
simplified: Every employer must pay an annual bonus to employees.
explanation: Mandatory 8.33% rate and 100 rupee floor omitted.

original: Every employer of a workplace shall, by an order in writing, constitute a Committee to be known as the Internal Complaints Committee at all administrative units where ten or more employees are employed.
simplified: Every employer with 10 or more workers at a workplace must form an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) through a written order.
explanation: Preserved statutory provision (POSH Act 2013, Section 4(1)).

original: Every employer of a workplace shall, by an order in writing, constitute a Committee to be known as the Internal Complaints Committee at all administrative units where ten or more employees are employed.
simplified: Workplaces employing 10 or more people are legally mandated to set up a written Internal Complaints Committee.
explanation: Accurate plain statement.

original: Every employer of a workplace shall, by an order in writing, constitute a Committee to be known as the Internal Complaints Committee at all administrative units where ten or more employees are employed.
simplified: Employers need to establish an Internal Complaints Committee only if the company employs more than 2,000 workers.
explanation: Threshold distorted from 10 employees to 2,000 employees.

original: Every employer of a workplace shall, by an order in writing, constitute a Committee to be known as the Internal Complaints Committee at all administrative units where ten or more employees are employed.
simplified: Forming an Internal Complaints Committee is completely voluntary even for workplaces with over ten employees.
explanation: Mandatory compliance weakened to voluntary choice.

original: Every employer of a workplace shall, by an order in writing, constitute a Committee to be known as the Internal Complaints Committee at all administrative units where ten or more employees are employed.
simplified: Every employer shall set up an Internal Complaints Committee.
explanation: 10-employee statutory threshold condition omitted.

original: In case the contractor fails to make payment of wages within the prescribed period or makes short payment, then the principal employer shall be liable to make payment of wages in full or the unpaid balance due to the contract labour employed by the contractor.
simplified: If a contractor fails to pay wages on time or pays less than required, the principal employer becomes legally responsible to pay the remaining wages directly to the contract workers.
explanation: Preserved statutory provision (Contract Labour Act 1970, Section 21(4)).

original: In case the contractor fails to make payment of wages within the prescribed period or makes short payment, then the principal employer shall be liable to make payment of wages in full or the unpaid balance due to the contract labour employed by the contractor.
simplified: The principal employer must step in and pay any unpaid wage balance if the contractor defaults.
explanation: Faithful plain summary.

original: In case the contractor fails to make payment of wages within the prescribed period or makes short payment, then the principal employer shall be liable to make payment of wages in full or the unpaid balance due to the contract labour employed by the contractor.
simplified: The principal employer bears zero legal responsibility if the contractor withholds workers' wages.
explanation: Principal employer statutory liability completely negated.

original: In case the contractor fails to make payment of wages within the prescribed period or makes short payment, then the principal employer shall be liable to make payment of wages in full or the unpaid balance due to the contract labour employed by the contractor.
simplified: Contract workers are liable to reimburse the principal employer whenever a contractor defaults.
explanation: Payment liability shifted onto contract workers.

original: In case the contractor fails to make payment of wages within the prescribed period or makes short payment, then the principal employer shall be liable to make payment of wages in full or the unpaid balance due to the contract labour employed by the contractor.
simplified: The principal employer is liable to pay unpaid wages when the contractor fails.
explanation: Valid concise restatement.

original: Every agreement by which any one is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of any kind, is to that extent void.
simplified: Any contract clause that prevents a person from practicing a lawful job, trade, or profession is legally void to that extent.
explanation: Preserved statutory provision (Indian Contract Act 1872, Section 27).

original: Every agreement by which any one is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of any kind, is to that extent void.
simplified: Agreements restraining someone from conducting a lawful trade or profession are legally unenforceable.
explanation: Accurate plain restatement.

original: Every agreement by which any one is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of any kind, is to that extent void.
simplified: Agreements banning former workers from ever practicing any lawful profession across the country are strictly binding and enforceable.
explanation: Section 27 voidness rule inverted into strict enforceability.

original: Every agreement by which any one is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business of any kind, is to that extent void.
simplified: Non-compete agreements stopping a lawful business are valid unless paid compensation.
explanation: Fabricated validity exception contradicting Section 27.

original: An agreement to do an act impossible in itself is void, and a contract to do an act which after the contract is made becomes impossible or unlawful becomes void when the act becomes impossible or unlawful.
simplified: An agreement to perform an impossible act is void from the start, and a valid contract becomes automatically void if performance later becomes impossible or illegal.
explanation: Preserved statutory provision (Indian Contract Act 1872, Section 56).

original: An agreement to do an act impossible in itself is void, and a contract to do an act which after the contract is made becomes impossible or unlawful becomes void when the act becomes impossible or unlawful.
simplified: Contracts that become impossible or illegal to perform after signing become legally void.
explanation: Faithful doctrine of frustration summary.

original: An agreement to do an act impossible in itself is void, and a contract to do an act which after the contract is made becomes impossible or unlawful becomes void when the act becomes impossible or unlawful.
simplified: Even after performance becomes physically impossible or illegal by statute, a party must still perform the contract or face imprisonment.
explanation: Doctrine of frustration inverted into mandatory penal enforcement.

original: An agreement to do an act impossible in itself is void, and a contract to do an act which after the contract is made becomes impossible or unlawful becomes void when the act becomes impossible or unlawful.
simplified: An agreement to do an impossible act is void.
explanation: Omitted supervening impossibility/illegality clause.

original: The insured persons, their dependants or the persons hereinafter mentioned, as the case may be, shall be entitled to the sickness benefit, maternity benefit, disablement benefit, and medical treatment.
simplified: Insured workers and their dependants are legally entitled to sickness pay, maternity benefit, disability compensation, and medical care under ESI.
explanation: Preserved statutory provision (Employees State Insurance Act 1948, Section 46).

original: The insured persons, their dependants or the persons hereinafter mentioned, as the case may be, shall be entitled to the sickness benefit, maternity benefit, disablement benefit, and medical treatment.
simplified: Covered workers and dependants are entitled to medical treatment as well as sickness, maternity, and disability benefits.
explanation: Accurate plain formulation.

original: The insured persons, their dependants or the persons hereinafter mentioned, as the case may be, shall be entitled to the sickness benefit, maternity benefit, disablement benefit, and medical treatment.
simplified: Only the employer and company directors can claim ESI sickness or medical care, excluding workers and dependants.
explanation: Insured beneficiaries replaced by employers.

original: The insured persons, their dependants or the persons hereinafter mentioned, as the case may be, shall be entitled to the sickness benefit, maternity benefit, disablement benefit, and medical treatment.
simplified: Only the worker receives treatment; dependants are permanently barred from medical coverage.
explanation: Statutory dependant coverage excluded.

original: The insured persons, their dependants or the persons hereinafter mentioned, as the case may be, shall be entitled to the sickness benefit, maternity benefit, disablement benefit, and medical treatment.
simplified: Insured workers can receive medical treatment under ESI.
explanation: Omitted dependants and cash sickness/maternity/disablement benefits.
